title: End Crystal Melee
description: Gives end crystals a powerful, balanced melee attack.
body:
# Description Allows you to use the End Crystal's explosion as a melee attack, dealing around 10 hearts of damage. Functions like a sword, but: * Same cooldown as a mace, and does not allow an attack if not fully charged, meaning aim is necessary (you have to draw it back enough to make it explode, also makes it balanced) * Deals explosion damage instead of regular damage, meaning it is affected by blast protection * Made only stackable to one to allow explosion sound and removing one item on use * Still placeable on obsidian, don't use it to break the crystal because of its cooldown + the other crystal won't explode if hit because crystals delete nearby crystals when they explode # Versions Supports Java 26.1-26.2
# Compatibility Incompatible with creative mode and anything changing the end crystal recipe.
